attack_question: Can frozen SKOLEM_LOCAL_DERIVATION_V1_1_SHIELDING_BRIDGE synthesize and locally certify exact Boolean guards whose semantics genuinely compose affine predicates with OR3 constraints, while separately carrying an exact domain proof and a shared witness-selection proof, without source-precompiled mixed guards or generic validity machinery?

inherited_rule_forms: GUARDED_ITE(guard, rule_true, rule_false) with hash-consed sharing
calculus_governance.derived_guard_typing_firewall: A synthesized Boolean rule root is not automatically promoted to a fresh atomic guard. Selector composition must either use a guard form already licensed by frozen V1.1 or structurally inline/compose the verified guard DAG without adding a rule form.
calculus_governance.internal_cover_witness_relevance: Not expected to be needed for this hostile; any use must satisfy the already frozen clausewise checker and is separately accounted.

exact_hostile_relation.boundary: One Boolean y_e per frozen graph edge.
exact_hostile_relation.graph: Connected simple 3-regular undirected graph G=(V,E), |V| a power of two, with odd charge ell:V->{0,1}.
exact_hostile_relation.base_affine_predicate: A_v(Y) := ell(v) XOR XOR_{e incident to v} y_e.
exact_hostile_relation.raw_affine_atoms: For each OR3 block j and k in {0,1,2}, source contains only a raw affine definition Z_{j,k}(Y) := c_{j,k} XOR XOR_{e in S_{j,k}} y_e. The three supports inside one block are pairwise disjoint, nonempty, and chosen away from the incident-edge supports of both vertices assigned to that block.
exact_hostile_relation.raw_or3_constraint: O_j(Y) := Z_{j,0}(Y) OR Z_{j,1}(Y) OR Z_{j,2}(Y), represented in source only as a raw OR3 constraint over the three affine atom ids; no Boolean output node is supplied.
exact_hostile_relation.pairing: Vertices are partitioned into deterministic frozen pairs. Each pair references exactly one OR3 block, so every O_j occurs for exactly two vertices.
exact_hostile_relation.candidate_interleave: For vertex v in pair j, exact admissibility guard is G_v(Y) := A_v(Y) XOR O_j(Y). Source stores only raw incidence linking v to its base affine constraint and OR3 block; it does not store G_v or any compiled Boolean DAG for G_v.
exact_hostile_relation.witness: Binary code of any vertex v whose exact mixed guard G_v(Y)=1.
exact_hostile_relation.totality_theorem: XOR_v G_v = XOR_v A_v XOR XOR_v O_pair(v) = 1 XOR 0 = 1, because every graph edge occurs twice in XOR_v A_v, total charge is odd, and every raw OR3 predicate occurs exactly twice under the frozen vertex pairing. Therefore D(Y)=TRUE for all boundary assignments.
exact_hostile_relation.domain_independence_contract: Pi_domain must certify totality from raw graph parity plus even OR3-block incidence. It may not import synthesized mixed-guard truth tables, witness outputs, or constructor claims.

proof_object.Pi_guard: Proof-carrying derivations of every exact G_v from raw A_v plus raw affine-atom definitions plus raw OR3 syntax, using only frozen V1.1 forms.
proof_object.Pi_select: Shared proof DAG selecting a witness vertex from the exact mixed guards. A mixed guard may not be treated as a magical atomic predicate merely because Pi_guard exists; composition must respect the frozen guard typing.
proof_object.Pi_domain: Independent symbolic certificate that D(Y)=TRUE by odd-charge cancellation plus even duplicated OR3-block incidence.

required_guard_synthesis_semantics.or3_compilation_example: For affine atom roots P,Q,R, OR3(P,Q,R) can be represented without a new OR3 rule by GUARDED_ITE(P, CONST(1), GUARDED_ITE(Q, CONST(1), R)), with each guard/child locally justified.
required_guard_synthesis_semantics.mixed_xor_example: G=A XOR O may be represented by branching on affine root A and using exact O / NOT O derivations in the children, or by an equivalent structurally inlined frozen-rule DAG.
required_guard_synthesis_semantics.shortcut_forbidden: The source may not hand the constructor an O or G Boolean node. The constructor must discover/build the exact derivation from raw constraints.

mandatory_killer_control.name: MIXED_EXACT_GUARD_COMPOSITION_CONTROL
mandatory_killer_control.raw_or3: O := P OR Q OR R
mandatory_killer_control.affine_only_shortcut_rejected_by: Hold O=1 and compare A=0 versus A=1; G changes as NOT A, so G is not the base affine predicate A and, because O is an OR3 of independent affine atoms, G is not affine in the underlying boundary bits.
mandatory_killer_control.or3_only_shortcut_rejected_by: Hold O=1 and flip independent A; O stays fixed while G flips.
mandatory_killer_control.independent_verifier_must_check: Raw affine supports are independent as preregistered; OR3 syntax is raw; the accepted proof uses only frozen rule forms; exact target semantics follows by local branch reduction.
mandatory_killer_control.hostile_execution_gate: The hostile series is forbidden unless this killer control passes both constructor and independent verifier.

source_freeze_policy.graph_generation: One deterministic seeded simple 3-regular graph candidate per n after deterministic structural generation; no resampling after any constructor observation.
source_freeze_policy.graph_gate: simple + 3-regular + connected; spectral ratio lambda2/3 is diagnostic metadata and must be <=0.99 or SOURCE_FAMILY_INVALID. It is not used to choose among candidates after constructor observation.
source_freeze_policy.charge_generation: Deterministic frozen bits, adjusted at one fixed predeclared vertex if necessary to make total XOR odd.
source_freeze_policy.pairing_generation: Deterministic frozen perfect matching over opaque vertex ids, generated before constructor exists.
source_freeze_policy.affine_atom_generation: For each pair, generate exactly three nonconstant affine atoms with pairwise-disjoint supports of fixed size 2; supports exclude graph edges incident to either paired vertex. Reuse across different pairs is permitted and fully frozen.
source_freeze_policy.or3_generation: Exactly one raw positive OR3 clause over the three affine atom ids per pair; both paired vertices reference the same clause id.
source_freeze_policy.interleave_gate: Combined incidence graph over graph vertices, graph-edge variables, affine atoms, and OR3 blocks must be connected.

structural_sets.G: Unique proof-DAG nodes reachable from all mixed-guard proof roots.
structural_sets.S: Unique proof-DAG nodes reachable from all witness-selection roots.

accounting.attribution_requirement: If total proof growth occurs, result must identify whether the observed pressure is in mixed-guard derivation, selector composition/sharing, domain certification, or shared overlap.

failure_taxonomy.FAIL_CALCULUS_EXPRESSIVITY: Mandatory mixed control cannot be represented under frozen V1.1 without a new rule or illicit guard typing.
failure_taxonomy.FAIL_MIXED_GUARD_SYNTHESIS_ACCESS: Required primitives are expressible and killer control passes, but frozen hostile constructor cannot derive exact G_v from raw mixed constraints without forbidden machinery.
failure_taxonomy.FAIL_MIXED_GUARD_REPRESENTATION_PRESSURE: Observed frozen-series growth is localized to Pi_guard and exceeds the preregistered resource envelope. This is an observed constructor outcome only, not a lower bound.
failure_taxonomy.FAIL_SELECTOR_SHARING: Exact mixed guards remain compact but composition into witness selection causes the observed resource failure or uncontrolled duplication.
failure_taxonomy.FAIL_DOMAIN_PROOF: Witness/guard objects may exist, but the independent exact domain certificate cannot be synthesized or verified under the frozen contract.
failure_taxonomy.FAIL_HIDDEN_GENERIC_VALIDATION: Any SAT, generic SKOLEM_VALID, generic tautology, unrestricted truth-table, reference result, or equivalent hidden oracle is used.
failure_taxonomy.FAIL_DOMAIN_DROPPED: Exact D is omitted, inferred from witness success, or totalized without the independent parity/incidence certificate.
failure_taxonomy.UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT: Authorized frozen run exhausts time or memory without a scientific lower-bound conclusion.
failure_taxonomy.SOURCE_FAMILY_INVALID: Frozen source violates graph, pairing, affine-atom independence, OR3, connectivity, hash, or provenance gates.
failure_taxonomy.PASS_SCOPED_MIXED_GUARD_HOSTILE_SYNTHESI: All mandatory control and frozen hostile instances carry exact mixed guards, selection proof, and independent domain proof with clean forbidden-machinery audit inside the preregistered resource envelope.
